### PrepareEoaWithdrawInput {#PrepareEoaWithdrawInput}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">withdrawals.PrepareEoaWithdrawInput</code></div>

```ts sdk-signature
interface PrepareEoaWithdrawInput extends StatusSource {
  pubkey: string;
  amount: bigint;
  fee?: bigint;
  acknowledgeFullExit?: boolean;
  from?: string;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>pubkey</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>amount</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei, whole gwei; 0 = full exit (needs acknowledgeFullExit). |
| <code>fee?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | Total fee in wei; default exactly the current fee (the predeploy keeps any excess). |
| <code>acknowledgeFullExit?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> |  |
| <code>from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | The sender, for the credentials check; default the wallet account. |
| <code>beaconUrl?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Beacon node REST URL, for the chain fallback. |
| <code>lockHash?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | The cluster lock of the pubkeys: only needed while the Obol API does not serve the deposit-status route (the interim `GET /v1/state/:lockHash` answers by lock). |
| <code>pendingRetry?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./core#PendingRetry">PendingRetry</a></span> | Re-reads of an Obol API deposit-status batch while an entry has `signaturesPending` (the API checks queued deposit signatures in the background, usually within a slot). Default `{ tries: 3, delayMs: 8000 }`: up to 3 requests, waiting 8 s then 16 s (about two slots). |

</div>
